section.name: Introduction
section.p: The QRCode plugin provides functionalities to generate and manage QR codes within the Lutece platform.

section.name: Configuration
section.p: To configure the QRCode plugin, follow these steps:

itemizedlist.item: Install the plugin by copying the JAR file to the WEB-INF/lib directory of your Lutece application.
Restart the Lutece application to load the plugin.
Access the plugin configuration page from the Lutece administration interface.

section.name: Usage
section.p: To use the QRCode plugin, follow these steps:

itemizedlist.item: Navigate to the QRCode generation page in the Lutece administration interface.
Enter the text or URL to be encoded into the QR code.
Select the desired size and error correction level for the QR code.
Click the "Generate" button to create the QR code.
Download the generated QR code image by clicking the "Download" button.
